definitions.explanation: A format or style in which participants actively take part rather than passively observe.

examples.japanese: {参加型|さんかがた}のイベントが{人気|にんき}だ。
この{授業|じゅぎょう}は{参加型|さんかがた}で、{学生|がくせい}が{意見|いけん}を{出|だ}し{合|あ}う。
examples.english: This class is participatory, with students sharing their opinions.

examples.japanese: {美術館|びじゅつかん}は{参加型|さんかがた}の{展示|てんじ}を{増|ふ}やし、{来場者|らいじょうしゃ}が{作品|さくひん}に{触|ふ}れられるようにしている。
examples.english: The museum has increased its interactive exhibits so that visitors can touch the works.

notes:
Composed of {参加|さんか} (participation) + {型|がた} (type, style). The suffix {型|がた} indicates a format or style, so {参加型|さんかがた} literally means "participation-type." Widely used as a modifier for events, classes, workshops, and digital content.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {参加型|さんかがた}イベント — participatory event
- {参加型|さんかがた}{授業|じゅぎょう} — interactive class
- {参加型|さんかがた}ワークショップ — participatory workshop
- {市民|しみん}{参加型|さんかがた} — citizen-participatory

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {体験型|たいけんがた} — experience-based, hands-on; emphasizes direct personal experience rather than just participation
- インタラクティブ — interactive; the loanword equivalent, used especially in digital and tech contexts
- {双方向|そうほうこう} — two-way, bidirectional; emphasizes mutual exchange rather than audience participation
